beats.text: Primary school in Ireland lasts 8 years. In the UAE, it's 4.
It counts the number of grades in primary school.
The shortest paths include the UAE, Germany, Russia, and Ukraine, all with 4 years.
India has 5 years. Brazil also has 5.
The USA, China, and Nigeria have 6. All 3 match the global median.
Australia is one of the highest, with 7 years of primary education.
Ireland has 8 years. That is 2 times the years the UAE has.
